data.dynamic_settings: Device settings (allow to read & set equipment settings)
data.raw_sensors: Device raw sensors (provide all available by wifi plug sensor fields)
data.direct_request_protocol: Direct data request (beta): near-realtime readings from the inverter via the DESS cloud relay. Set the direct protocol to match your inverter: Axpert/PI30, SMG-II Modbus (Anenji, EASUN SMG, devcode 2376) or PI18
